description: A version range the adapter can satisfy: it negotiates 1, declares a manifest that claims live retrieval and as_of none, and answers a health probe. Health is a td info probe plus the workspace listing, so the record count, the coverage, and the watermark all come from the workspace rather than from the fact that a command returned. The identity is the base name of the directory the location resolves to, and the case also declares it as the `workspace` setting, so the diagnostics record an identity that was asserted as well as observed — a setting naming anything else is refused at the handshake rather than renaming another workspace's database. A replaying instance claims no store, because a recording is not a database.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
